scoring_justification: The verifier sandbox cannot rerun DFT; only the final adsorption energies are reported. T0 result-level compare against paper-reported values with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies for AuCl4- on carbon site adjacent to N in v-2D-COF-Dz and on N site in v-2D-COF-Pz
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4g and associated text: Dz adsorption energy -0.79 eV, Pz adsorption energy -0.63 eV
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the actual paper-reported numbers for the two COFs under the specified adsorption sites; no synthesis or holdout required.

outputs.description: The adsorption energy of AuCl4- on the carbon site adjacent to nitrogen in v-2D-COF-Dz, and on the nitrogen site in v-2D-COF-Pz. Both values in electronvolts.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the agent's computed adsorption energies to the paper-reported reference values within a tolerance and verifies that the Dz value is more negative (stronger adsorption) than the Pz value.

steps.description: Check dz_adsorption_energy_eV within 0.1 eV of hidden gold -0.79 eV
Check pz_adsorption_energy_eV within 0.1 eV of hidden gold -0.63 eV
Check that dz_adsorption_energy_eV < pz_adsorption_energy_eV (stronger adsorption on Dz)
